## About
At Platinum AC & Heating, air conditioning repair in Houston is what we specialize in. We work on both residential and commercial properties, and we install and maintain furnaces, air conditioners, boilers, fireplaces and water heaters.
Our neighbors know the crew by name. One customer wrote that Dwayne, Roger and Jose worked non stop, explained everything along the way and itemized it all, from equipment to warranties, with no sales pitch.
We want you comfortable at home, so we keep repairs quick and pricing fair. Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 29 Google reviews. Try us; we won't disappoint you.

## Services
- AC repair and install: All aspects of air conditioning work for domestic and commercial customers, from new installs to fixing a unit that has stopped cooling.
- Air conditioning repair and maintenance: Regular servicing keeps your air conditioning running smoothly all year, and when something breaks we make the repair professional, cost effective and efficient.
- Furnace repair and installation: Furnace systems are complicated. Our experienced technicians repair and install them, and regular maintenance heads off the mechanical problems behind gas furnace trouble.
- Heating systems: Heating for retail offices and high end residential spaces using oil, gas or air source heat pumps, plus ground source heat pumps paired with air conditioning.
- Boilers, fireplaces and water heaters: We install and maintain boilers, fireplaces and water heaters along with your heating and cooling equipment.
- Air duct cleaning: Your ducts carry warm and cool air through the whole house. A professional cleaning helps indoor air quality and your family's health.
- Indoor air quality: Pollution testing and sampling for problems like mold, bacteria, chemicals, allergens and dust.
- Realtor special pricing: Selling a home? Our technicians inspect, repair and certify the condition of your air conditioning, heating and water heater before you list. Realtors and their clients can call for special pricing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial properties too?
A: Yes. Our services are available for both residential and commercial premises.

Q: I'm a landlord. Can you help with my tenants' AC?
A: Yes. Two customers wrote about calls we handled for their rentals and tenants, and one couple uses us for their properties.

Q: I'm selling my home. What can you do before I list?
A: Our technicians inspect, repair and certify the condition of your air conditioning, heating and water heater before your home goes on the market. Realtors and their clients can call us for special pricing.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM Monday, Tuesday and Thursday through Sunday. We're closed on Wednesday.
